relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Monoclonal antibodies (erenumab, fremanezumab, galcanezumab, eptinezumab) and small-molecule receptor antagonists (ubrogepant, rimegepant, atogepant) have shown efficacy in episodic and chronic migraine.

key_findings: CGRP monoclonal antibodies (including galcanezumab) are mainly for long-term prevention, while ubrogepant and rimegepant given early at onset increase pain and symptom relief.
Both drug classes reduce monthly migraine days with favorable tolerability and minimal vascular effects.
